Name: Kenneth's Fancy Pastries and Cakes
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b]Adds 9 custom fancy pastries and cakes to Kenneth's Bakery - pistachio frosted cupcake, chocolate chip muffin, stacked berry macarons, vanilla chocolate eclair, red velvet layer cake slice, cinnamon swirl roll, matcha glazed donut, pistachio swirl bundt cake, and chocolate chunk cookie cake - each with its own cooking recipe and buffs![/b]

[b]Requires Kenneth's Bakery - this mod's items are sold in its Shop.[/b]

[b]Customization: By default, all pastries and cakes appear in Kenneth's Bakery Shop. If you want to customize your selection and have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can disable individual pastries and cakes to remove them from the shop along with their cooking recipes. Re-enabling a pastry or cake restores it to the shop and its recipe to your kitchen.[/b]
